def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    demands = instance["demands"]
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers))

    # --- helpers ---
    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0
        for v in rt:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

    def two_opt_best(rt):
        n = len(rt)
        if n < 4:
            return rt
        best = rt
        best_c = route_cost(rt)
        improved = True
        # Deterministic first-improvement with bounded scans
        while improved:
            improved = False
            # Try swaps (i, k) with i<k
            for i in range(n - 1):
                for k in range(i + 1, n):
                    # reverse segment i..k
                    cand = rt[:i] + rt[i : k + 1][::-1] + rt[k + 1 :]
                    if len(cand) != n:
                        continue
                    c = best_c
                    # Recompute fully for safety (n up to ~200, still fine)
                    c = route_cost(cand)
                    if c + 1e-9 < best_c:
                        best = cand
                        best_c = c
                        rt = cand
                        n = len(rt)
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best

    def relocate_tries(routes, max_passes=3):
        # Deterministic "best improvement" relocate: move one customer from a position to best end of another route.
        def best_insert_end(from_rt, idx_from, to_rt):
            v = from_rt[idx_from]
            if not to_rt:
                # insert single
                delta = matrix[depot][v] + matrix[v][depot]
                return delta, [v]
            # try append
            old = matrix[depot][to_rt[0]] + matrix[to_rt[-1]][depot]
            old += 0
            # cost of to_rt excluding depot legs:
            old_inner = 0
            for t in range(len(to_rt) - 1):
                old_inner += matrix[to_rt[t]][to_rt[t + 1]]
